supportedClaims: Ground-state energy within the fixed-hamming-weight=1 sector of a supplied two-qubit real Pauli Hamiltonian
Noiseless statevector VQE result using the versioned single-excitation ansatz and deterministic optimizer
outOfScope: Deriving or validating a Hamiltonian from molecular geometry
QAOA, excited states, noisy simulation, finite shots, and physical quantum hardware
Hamiltonians containing Y operators, complex coefficients, more than two qubits, or a different particle sector

checks.criterion: The request exactly matches the supplied two-qubit statevector VQE scope.
The canonical Pauli terms and digest are reproducible from the input.
The maximum Hermiticity residual divided by S_H=max(1,sum(abs(Pauli coefficients))) is within numerical precision.
The maximum cross-sector matrix element divided by S_H is within numerical precision.
An independent closed-form diagonalization reproduces the reference energy with absolute difference normalized by max(S_H,abs(recomputed),abs(reported)).
The exact-reference eigenpair residual norm divided by S_H is within numerical tolerance.
The reported VQE energy is finite and explicitly expressed in Hartree.
The VQE statevector norm differs from one by no more than the threshold.

Rebuilding the versioned ansatz from optimalThetaRadians reproduces the reported state. The checked metric is the maximum of outside-sector probability, one-minus phase-insensitive fidelity, and phase-aligned maximum amplitude residual.
Replaying the Pauli expectation from the statevector reproduces the reported energy with absolute difference normalized by max(S_H,abs(replayed),abs(reported)).
The negative part of the variational gap divided by max(S_H,abs(VQE),abs(exact)) is no greater than numerical slack.
The VQE energy differs from the exact sector reference by at most 1.6 mHa for this profile.
The deterministic optimizer reaches a final angular bracket width no greater than the threshold before exhausting the evaluation budget.

The trace has contiguous evaluation numbers, 64 unique periodic coarse nodes, replayable normalized energies, a correct monotone running best, result-to-trace consistency, truthful bracket/budget termination, and a deterministic independent rerun with the same canonical best. The metric is the maximum normalized energy replay residual; every structural invariant must also hold.
The number of statevector expectation evaluations does not exceed the profile budget.
Input, Hamiltonian, tool, environment, and artifact digests are present and mutually consistent.
